title: Quick Pro frame geometry collection (AR/ER/XR/TR/SR/GR/TT)
notes: Community-compiled collection of Quick Pro geometry charts and rider-height size guides across several frame models. Each selected chart is mapped to the model named in its own header; values should be checked against Quick's official geometry before purchase.

capture.scope: Archived public post; the selected photos were reviewed from the original files, which remain outside Git.
